sources.E: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list
sources.O: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List guide (Nov 19, 2026)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one lands on its own the moment the other 54 are yours. Plan around roughly 200 hours: the story is the short part, and the counters plus the 100% checklist are what actually eat the clock.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the tutorial and cannot be skipped. From here on, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission. Before the final one, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it exists only in Chapter 1, and finishing the chapter locks it away for good.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Partway through, Jason and Lucia both become playable, which switches on the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy). Start the chapter with a fresh manual save in a new slot.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The Race Against Yago strand appears in this chapter and is time-sensitive, and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun that Sneakthief needs. Manual save at the chapter start.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near its end, clear the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — it unlocks the bank vaults that Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist both need.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Save manually in a fresh slot immediately before the final mission — with no mission replay, that save is your only clean way back. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so nothing else is urgent.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Story missions cannot be missed or failed for good: a bad run simply retries the checkpoint.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3, a set-piece on the critical path. It cannot be skipped or locked out, and failures retry from checkpoints.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play in Chapter 4. It sits on the critical path, and checkpoint retries cover any failure.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners in Chapter 4, part of the main sequence. Nothing here is missable, and checkpoints retry any failure.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown late in the story. While you are at the airport, note gates E3 and E4 — a passenger jet at a boarding bridge there is what Catch Me If You Can asks you to steal in free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a late-game set piece on the critical path. Keep the manual save you made at its chapter's start.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the credits, open Progress > Stats for the game's own 100% checklist and complete every line. The heavy lines: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 vehicles and all 39 gang operations — start those counters early.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Take every ramp, rooftop and drawbridge you pass from the first hour. Stunt jumps bank permanently, so opportunistic detours beat a dedicated grind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so treat 250 as the trophy line and keep going.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of each of the nine activity types — races, fishing, drone events, range challenges and the rest. You only have to try each once, not win. Sweep the map icons as they unlock from Chapter 2.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Work the range's 42 challenges weapon class by weapon class. Gold means accuracy under the clock, so learn each gun's recoil on the early static lanes before the timed and moving ones.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone courses and only a win at each one counts. Run a new course once to learn its gates, then rerun it at once while the line is fresh — winning times are generous once you stop clipping scenery.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Re-winning the same race adds nothing: move to fresh race markers until 20 different events are won. Where the rules allow, bring a car a class above the field.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Enter a fishing challenge against Cal and out-catch him before the clock ends. Practise on ordinary spots first, and take the challenge on a calm morning when the water is busy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade cabinet and play one game through to completion. Pick the shortest cabinet in the room.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand through to its final mission. Strand finales stay available after the credits, so there is no deadline on this one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's strand to its final mission. It stays on the map after the credits, so finish it whenever it suits the run.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Nothing in the strand expires, and the finales make ideal filler between counter grinds.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger strands. One warning: the Chapter 3 strand Race Against Yago is time-sensitive — the moment it appears, drop everything and run it. The others wait; that one does not.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's strand through to its final mission. It stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. The strand finales batch neatly into one post-credits sweep.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 before anything else — it counts toward the 18 and vanishes for good when Chapter 1 ends; it is the one true missable in the game. The other 17 spots wait as long as you need.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and track the unique animal he names. Follow his markers and prepare before the final approach.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect every card in three full trading-card sets. Cards hide on rooftops, pier ends, back rooms and lookout points — finish one set fully before spreading your effort across the others.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Make it a habit from the first hour: every time you arrive somewhere new — a shop, a strand start, a viewpoint — use WAiNK It. As a reflex it fills itself long before the endgame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Work the Challenges list from the easy categories upward; 50 banks the trophy. The 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, so the stubborn remainder belongs to the endgame grind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Partner trophies only count with Jason and Lucia together, from Chapter 2. Raise a 4-star wanted level and lose it properly: break line of sight, ditch the hot car, and stay out of search cones together until the stars drain.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick three shops close together on the same street, partner beside you, and rob them in one unbroken run — the wanted level must never fully clear between shops. Move fast, stay in one vehicle, and never hide long enough for the heat to die.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A model counts the first time you drive it. Rich districts plus airport and marina parking are the fastest hunting grounds. The 100% checklist wants 200, so every early steal counts twice.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming. Trigger it mid gang operation with five or more enemies in one sightline and drop five before the meter empties. Line your shots up first — reloading inside the short meter wastes the window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to gates E3 or E4 at VCIA, steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding bridge, and take off. No chase to survive and no destination matters — pick a quiet moment on the apron.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Drive to Mile Zero Air Station in the far southwest, where Rhino tanks patrol. Heavy weapons and distance are your friends; the trophy follows the encounter.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Jewelry robberies unlock in the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun. Use it on Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds' back door, read the safe-code note inside, and empty the safe without being detected. Walk, do not run, and leave the way you came in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vaults stay locked until the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4, opens them. Then rob five vaults and escape each time. The 100% checklist wants all eight emptied.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on its route, stop it, crack the rear doors, take the cash, then break away and stay gone until the wanted level clears. A fast car staged before the hit makes the escape a formality.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Pass through all 52 named areas — the map registers each one as you enter. Chase the grey patches when crossing the state, and leave a plane or boat sweep of the coastline for the last holdouts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations, and one robbery against each is the whole ask. Vary your targets from the start — the 100% checklist eventually demands all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and take it in with the ocean in front of you. A pure moment trophy: no skill, no timer, made for a Chapter 1 evening on the beachfront.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive straight out through the glass. Any showroom with a car on the floor works.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete your follow-through on the lane. One honest game is what the trophy watches for.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Partner content is only live with Jason and Lucia both in play, from Chapter 2 onward. Work the shared activities as a pair rather than solo, and this partnership moment registers along the way.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game quietly counts your choices and actions toward 500, and ordinary play fills it — missions, strands, robberies, activities. Do not grind it; check during the endgame and it will almost certainly be done.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The precise trigger is not yet pinned down. The description points at failing once and succeeding the second time: whenever a challenge, race or minigame offers a retry right after a failure, take it and finish the job. That fail-then-succeed pattern is the best current understanding.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What triggers this one is not yet pinned down. The wording points at witnessing some scripted strangeness out in Leonida — explore the odd corners of the state, especially after dark, and let the weird find you; it most likely pops on its own.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Drive slowly past someone on foot and swing a melee attack from the vehicle as you pass — the hit must connect from the moving car. Low speed and a close line are everything; a crowded sidewalk gives several chances in one pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Feed marked bills to your laundering contacts until $250,000 has come out clean. Heist payouts and vault scores are the richest source of marked bills — route that money through the laundry instead of spending it raw.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across any shops — every till counts. The eight garages alone run to roughly $160,000, so this pops on its own partway through buying property for Little Boxes.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Open the Vice City Real Estate app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and buy all eight garages — roughly $160,000 in total. Buy as the money lands; every purchase also feeds the $100,000 spending trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app opens through the Chapter 2 mission Moses. After that, register ten vehicles to it as you acquire them — register each new car when you first park it.
